items.title: 1 Consumer Stock to Target This Week and 2 Facing Headwinds
items.summary: Retailers are adapting their business models as technology changes how people shop. Still, demand can be volatile as the industry is exposed to the ups and downs of consumer spending. This has stirred some uncertainty lately as retail stocks have lagged the market over the past six months, posting a return of 1.9% compared to 12.7% for the S&P 500.

items.title: CDC Declares Cyclospora Outbreak Linked to Iceberg Lettuce as Over
items.summary: The outbreak, which federal health officials linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from supplier Taylor Farms, resulted in a total of 12,883 reported cases of the gastrointestinal food-borne illness across 21 states.

items.title: Should You Buy Walmart Stock After a 14% Decline in Six Months?
items.summary: Walmart's 14% six-month slide improves its entry point, but premium valuation, cost pressures and weaker estimates argue for patience.

items.title: Costco Price Prediction: A $1,200 Target Comes Into Focus
items.summary: Costco just delivered a quietly excellent quarter and the stock pulled back anyway, which raises a question worth answering: does the selloff signal a structural crack in the warehouse giant's model or the kind of entry point that only appears a few times a decade?

items.title: Crumbs: Robinhood Chain Backed Startup Pushes Stock Tokenization Into Shopping Rewards
items.summary: Very few startups generate as much hype in their first week as Crumbs has managed to do. The startup promising to give shoppers stock tokens from the companies they buy from is already causing a stir among investors and VCs, with many closely watching the idea of turning everyday spending into an investment.
